event: Snowstorm during the evening commute ('Commutageddon'); traffic gridlock after 4 p.m.
evidence_quote: Photo caption: 'Traffic was at a standstill at 8:30 p.m. on Rt. 50 on January 26, 2011'

event: Magnitude 5.8 Virginia earthquake at 1:51 p.m.; monuments, museums and city buildings evacuated, Metro slowed to 15 mph
evidence_quote: 'Tuesday, August 23, 2011' ... 'The District's monuments and museums were evacuated'

event: Hurricane Irene: gusts over 50 mph, about 4 inches of rain at Reagan National, about 850,000 outages in Maryland and DC
Remnants of Tropical Storm Lee: heavy rain, worst flash flooding 7 to 8 September, major roads closed
evidence_quote: 'beginning on September 6th and continued through September 9th'

event: Early-season winter storm; only a trace of snow at Reagan National
evidence_quote: 'A significant winter storm impacted the area on Oct. 29' ... 'a trace of snow across the immediate metro area, including DCA'

event: Derecho reached DC about 9 to 11:35 p.m. on 29 June; 65 to 75 mph gusts, power out for up to a week
evidence_quote: 'from 8:57 p.m. to 11:35 p.m. EDT June 29' ... 'Power in some areas took nearly a week to be restored'

event: Record heat: 105 °F, 10th straight day at or above 95 °F
evidence_quote: 'today's official high will go down as 105, breaking the previous July 7 record'

event: Hurricane Sandy: federal offices closed 29 to 30 Oct, Metro rail and bus cancelled 29 Oct, resumed 2 p.m. 30 Oct
evidence_quote: 'closed federal offices in the Washington, D.C., area to the public on October 29 and 30' ... 'reopened on October 31'
